originalTitle: Wall Street indexes slip as oil prices rise, retail results awaited
summary: VIDEO SHOWS: n/a STORY: U.S. stocks fell on Monday, with the Dow and S&P 500 each shedding roughly half a percent, and the Nasdaq dropping about a third of a percent. :: Home Depot With July's weak retail sales and jobs data fresh in their minds, investors were cautious as they waited for quarterly results from retailers. Home Depot is due to report on Tuesday, TJ Maxx's parent company on Wednesday, and retail bellwether Walmart on Thursday. Anna Rathbun is founder and CEO of Grenadilla Advisory. "I'll be looking for more of the K-shaped economy narrative for the consumers, especially from companies like Walmart, TJ Maxx, and to a certain degree, Target as well. And what these companies are doing really to help the lower leg of the K-shaped economy, as well as trying to capture market share of people who are trying to stretch the dollar a little bit further coming from the middle class." Among individual stock moves, Microsoft and Meta Platforms provided the biggest drags on the S&P 500, with both declining more than 3%. Chip stocks provided a boost with Micron Technology adding 4% and Applied Materials climbing 5.5%. Meanwhile, oil futures settled up more than $2 per barrel as investor pessimism about diplomatic efforts to resolve the Iran war fanned global supply worries. That provided a boost to stocks of energy companies. Energy was the sole gainer among the S&P 500's 11 major sectors.

chineseTitle: 随着油价上涨，华尔街指数下滑，等待零售业绩
chineseSummary: 视频显示：无故事：美国股市周一下跌，道指和标准普尔 500 指数均下跌约 0.5%，纳斯达克指数下跌约 1/3%。 :: Home Depot 7 月份零售销售和就业数据疲软，投资者在等待零售商季度业绩时保持谨慎。家得宝 (Home Depot) 将于周二发布报告，TJ Maxx 的母公司将于周三发布报告，零售业领头羊沃尔玛将于周四发布报告。 Anna Rathbun 是 Grenadilla Advisory 的创始人兼首席执行官。 “我会为消费者寻找更多关于 K 型经济的叙述，尤其是来自沃尔玛、TJ Maxx 等公司，在某种程度上，塔吉特也是如此。这些公司正在做的事情确实是为了帮助 K 型经济的下半身，并试图从那些试图进一步扩大美元收入的中产阶级中夺取市场份额。”个股走势中，微软和 Meta Platforms 对标普 500 指数的拖累最大，双双下跌超过 3%。芯片股提振，美光科技 (Micron Technology) 上涨 4%，应用材料 (Applied Materials) 上涨 5.5%。与此同时，由于投资者对解决伊朗战争的外交努力的悲观情绪加剧了全球供应担忧，石油期货价格每桶上涨超过 2 美元。这提振了能源公司的股票。能源是标准普尔 500 指数 11 个主要板块中唯一上涨的板块。
